title: Superlative Adjectives (the oldest, the most important) - Basic superlatives

options.answer: This is the bigest building in the city.
This is the most big building in the city.
This is the biggest building in the city.

explanation.en: For one-syllable adjectives like 'big', you add '-est' to form the superlative. The final consonant is doubled before adding '-est'.
explanation.ru: Для односложных прилагательных, таких как 'big', для образования превосходной степени добавляется '-est'. Конечная согласная удваивается перед добавлением '-est'.
explanation.uz: 'big' kabi bir bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun orttirma darajani yasash uchun '-est' qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi. '-est' qo'shilishidan oldin oxirgi undosh harf ikki marta yoziladi.

options.answer: She is the more beautiful girl in the class.
She is the most beautiful girl in the class.
She is the beautifullest girl in the class.

explanation.en: For long adjectives with three or more syllables, you use 'the most' to form the superlative. 'Beautiful' has three syllables.
explanation.ru: Для длинных прилагательных с тремя или более слогами, чтобы образовать превосходную степень, используется 'the most'. 'Beautiful' имеет три слога.
explanation.uz: Uch yoki undan ortiq bo'g'inli uzun sifatlar uchun orttirma darajani yasash uchun 'the most' ishlatiladi. 'Beautiful' so'zida uchta bo'g'in bor.

options.answer: My brother is the tallest person in my family.
My brother is the most tall person in my family.
My brother is the taller person in my family.

explanation.en: For short adjectives like 'tall', you add '-est' to form the superlative. We also use 'the' before the superlative adjective.
explanation.ru: Для коротких прилагательных, таких как 'tall', для образования превосходной степени добавляется '-est'. Мы также используем 'the' перед превосходной степенью прилагательного.
explanation.uz: 'tall' kabi qisqa sifatlar uchun orttirma darajani yasash uchun '-est' qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi. Shuningdek, biz orttirma sifatdan oldin 'the' artiklini ishlatamiz.

options.answer: This is the more difficult exercise.
This is the difficultest exercise.
This is the most difficult exercise.

explanation.en: 'Difficult' is a long adjective, so the superlative form is 'the most difficult', not 'difficultest'.
explanation.ru: 'Difficult' — это длинное прилагательное, поэтому превосходная степень — 'the most difficult', а не 'difficultest'.
explanation.uz: 'Difficult' uzun sifat bo'lgani uchun uning orttirma darajasi 'the most difficult' bo'ladi, 'difficultest' emas.

options.answer: He is the happyest boy in the world.
He is the most happy boy in the world.
He is the happiest boy in the world.

explanation.en: For two-syllable adjectives ending in '-y', we change the 'y' to 'i' and add '-est' to form the superlative.
explanation.ru: Для двухсложных прилагательных, оканчивающихся на '-y', мы меняем 'y' на 'i' и добавляем '-est' для образования превосходной степени.
explanation.uz: Oxiri '-y' harfiga tugaydigan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun orttirma darajani yasashda 'y' harfi 'i' ga o'zgaradi va '-est' qo'shiladi.

options.answer: That is the worse movie I have ever seen.
That is the most bad movie I have ever seen.
That is the worst movie I have ever seen.

explanation.en: 'Bad' is an irregular adjective. Its superlative form is 'the worst'.
explanation.ru: 'Bad' — это неправильное прилагательное. Его превосходная степень — 'the worst'.
explanation.uz: 'Bad' noto'g'ri sifatdir. Uning orttirma darajasi 'the worst' bo'ladi.

options.answer: She is the goodest student in our class.
She is the better student in our class.
She is the best student in our class.

explanation.en: 'Good' is an irregular adjective. Its superlative form is 'the best'.
explanation.ru: 'Good' — это неправильное прилагательное. Его превосходная степень — 'the best'.
explanation.uz: 'Good' noto'g'ri sifatdir. Uning orttirma darajasi 'the best' bo'ladi.

options.answer: This is the least interesting book I've ever read.
This is the most less interesting book I've ever read.
This is the less interestingest book I've ever read.

explanation.en: To express the lowest degree, we use 'the least' before the adjective. 'Interesting' is a long adjective.
explanation.ru: Чтобы выразить наименьшую степень, мы используем 'the least' перед прилагательным. 'Interesting' — это длинное прилагательное.
explanation.uz: Eng past darajani ifodalash uchun sifatdan oldin 'the least' ishlatamiz. 'Interesting' - bu uzun sifat.

options.answer: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is the more high mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is the most high mountain in the world.

explanation.en: 'High' is a one-syllable adjective, so its superlative form is 'the highest'.
explanation.ru: 'High' — это односложное прилагательное, поэтому его превосходная степень — 'the highest'.
explanation.uz: 'High' bir bo'g'inli sifat, shuning uchun uning orttirma darajasi 'the highest' bo'ladi.

options.answer: He is the cleverest student in the class.
He is the most clever student in the class.
Both A and B are correct.

explanation.en: For two-syllable adjectives ending in '-er', '-le', '-ow', or '-y', you can use either '-est' or 'the most'. 'Clever' is a two-syllable adjective ending in '-er'.
explanation.ru: Для двухсложных прилагательных, оканчивающихся на '-er', '-le', '-ow' или '-y', можно использовать как '-est', так и 'the most'. 'Clever' — это двухсложное прилагательное, оканчивающееся на '-er'.
explanation.uz: Oxiri '-er', '-le', '-ow' yoki '-y' harflariga tugaydigan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun '-est' yoki 'the most' ishlatish mumkin. 'Clever' '-er' harfiga tugaydigan ikki bo'g'inli sifat.
